entry_lifecycle.catalyst_logic: The New Zealand policy surprise is already in the kiwi. The edge is the overshoot in the cross plus a 3.5 five-year NZDUSD print, not a fresh policy meeting. Cut if Hormuz risk-off takes kiwi through recent lows and the cross makes new highs.

entry_rationale: Independent take of the only expanding handoff: short the 1.2456 cross, 99.6 five-year percentile, with kiwi already washed out at 0.5627. This is a singles-and-doubles FX fade, not a New Zealand rates ticket, and it does not duplicate the Canada receive. Size stays 20 million because Hormuz and oil can still extend kiwi cheapness.
entry_thesis: March Canada still prices 37.5 basis points of hike versus 2.55 cash, so the 450 million receive stays the core and does not need harvest. The New Zealand versus US 10-year residual has fully retraced from about 23 basis points cheap to zero, and I am flattening it rather than nursing a name I cannot add. AUDNZD at 1.2456 is a 99.6 five-year extreme with kiwi already at a 3.5 five-year cheap print after the late-October New Zealand surprise; a 20 million short of the cross is a tactical FX single that diversifies Canada duration without touching New Zealand sovereign yields.

The Australian dollar-kiwi short is cut from 20 million to 10 million because a full-size hold would not be initiated again at 1.2266. The Australia September pay at 4.705 versus 4.85 cash is skipped. The gap is too tight, and a higher Australia rate leans against the cross short.

harvest_obligation.question: If flat today, would you initiate this exact trade at this exact size and level?

invalidation: The receive is wrong if March Canada implieds reverse back through 3.13 on an oil-led Bank of Canada re-hike. The cross is wrong if AUDNZD holds above 1.2456 and extends on a Hormuz risk-off that keeps liquidating kiwi. Flatten the new FX if the 99th-percentile stretch persists without any mean-reversion over the tactical window.
